extracted.name: Gajar halwa rolls
ingredient_lines: as needed Water to make slurry
instruction_lines: Had some leftover gajar halwa Suddenly a few guests came Now had to serve desserts But wanted them in a different way
For this Take spring roll sheets Place 2 tbsp of gajar halwa on a side
Make slurry with maida and water
Apply slurry on the sides of the sheet and roll like you do for spring rolls
Heat oil in a flat pan When it becomes hot, fry the halwa rolls Take out when it’s fried nicely
Keep on the absorbent paper Cut slantingly
Serve hot halwa rolls with cold vanilla ice cream
